entities.summary: William Bauchop Wilson was an American labor leader and progressive politician who served as the first United States Secretary of Labor from 1913 to 1921 under President Woodrow Wilson. After having worked as a child and adult in the coal mines of Pennsylvania, he became active as a labor organizer.
